basic_info.description: Stunning corner unit at the Francisco Palms, a beautiful boutique 16 unit building in the heart of the Marina District. This exceptional home has been meticulously upgraded to the highest standards, thoughtfully blending bespoke design with the classic charm of its original features. From the moment you enter, you'll be captivated by the spacious rooms, soaring ceilings, and incredible natural light that fills every corner. The kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring custom cabinetry, luxurious Pental Quartz countertops, a central island, gas range, wine fridge, and abundant storage. The spacious, light-filled living room flows effortlessly into the formal dining area, perfect for entertaining. Custom cabinetry and shelving, including a built-in buffet and wet bar make this space as functional as it is stylish. The spa-like bathroom boasts a dual vanity, Lefroy Brooks faucets, Carrara marble countertops, walk-in shower, and a soaking tub. This special property is short walk to some of the city's best nightlife and dining on Chestnut Street as well as easy access to endless outdoor pursuits at Aquatic Park, Chrissy Field, Fort Mason, Marina Green, and Francisco Park. 1 car garage parking & extra storage included.
